title: What costroid policy --json prints, version 0.1
description: The verdict costroid policy gives offline, as the check's machine block carries it under policy, with the object's name in its first key. docs/policy.md describes each field of the verdict.

conclusion.description: What the check would conclude on this verdict.

trust.description: How far the rows are checked. Offline they are the job's own, so it reads unverified.

config.description: Whether the costroid.yml named was found, and whether it is valid.

evaluated_at.description: When the verdict was reached, in RFC 3339.

results.description: One entry for each rule that ran: the rule, its outcome and its reason.
